text:
tess: heads up — seeing a big drop in available GPU capacity in us-west2-b, ~38% of GPUs in that AZ went NotReady in the last 4m. Pods are getting evicted with NetworkUnavailable.

samir: on it. I see BGP flaps reported from cloud provider in us-west2-b. Pods show `Evicted: node condition: network` in logs. Can we cordon the remaining nodes there to stop churn?

matt: cordoning now. command: ```kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia-gpu -o wide | grep us-west2-b
kubectl cordon <node-name>
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data\``` Doing one node at a time.

deploy-bot: [alert] Deployment rollout paused for model-serving/us-west2-b due to nodeDrain events.

samir: also bumped autoscaler preference to avoid us-west2-b: `gcloud compute instance-groups set-autoscaling model-pool --zone=us-west2-b --max-num-replicas=0` (temporary). Redirecting new allocation requests to us-west2-c and us-west1-a.

renee: FYI this will incur cross-region egress for in-flight KV cache fetches if we serve from us-west1. cost estimate ~$700/hr if sustained. Can we prefer us-west2-c first?

matt: yes, shifted weight: `router set-weight model-serving us-west2-c=0.7,us-west1-a=0.3` — keeping us-west1 as fallback.

tess: rolling internal alert to customers: short blip expected, fallback to other zones, no data loss. Template sent in #general.

samir: monitoring resource manager — GPU counts stabilizing at ~90% across region after shift. Need to watch for resumed BGP flaps.

matt: leaving nodes cordoned for now. If provider doesn't fix by +30m we'll migrate reserved pools to us-west2-c and notify sales.

renee: opened cost watch. If egress > $500 in an hour switch to dedicated reserved fallback to avoid unpredictable spend.

tess: noted. updating postmortem draft pointer: `docs/incidents/1772003456-us-west2-b-network-flap.md`

samir: adding kernel log snippet: ```dmesg | tail -n 20
[ 12345.678901] skyward-network: link down on eth0
[ 12345.679002] kubelet: node not ready: NetworkUnavailable\```

matt: thanks. will reconvene in 15m. @oncall-ops please keep watch on autoscaler and router.

oncall-ops: ack :white_check_mark: monitoring.
